description: This file is a PHP template partial that constructs the navigation bar content, including branding and an optional search form, for a website.
external_files: XML namespace 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' in the SVG element

methods.name: $config->getBasePage()
methods.description: Retrieves the base page URL component for building the href of the brand link.

methods.name: $config->getIndex()->getUri()
methods.description: Retrieves the URI for the index page to append to the base page URL in the brand link.

methods.name: $config->getTitle()
methods.description: Retrieves the title to display as the brand name/link text.

methods.name: $config->getHTML()->hasSearch()
methods.description: Checks if the search functionality should be included in the navigation bar.

methods.name: $this->translate()
methods.description: Translates given keys for placeholder text and accessibility labels in the search input field.
